parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: The name of the command that has caused the process to exist.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size in {{units}} of the memory occupied by the process.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the process where 0 is highest.

parameters.name: CPUTime
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the process has spent taking up CPU time since the process was started.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The current state that the process is in.

object.description: List of all processes running on the device.
